name: Failed Module initialization exposes no partial state and does not retry

input.fixture_ref: Fail a dependency Module after staging state, access it and its dependent twice, then perform an explicit reload.

applicability.reason: Requires persistent Module load-attempt state, confirmed by measurement rather than assumed. C018 needs three observables: no partial Module visible, the failed Module AND its dependents staying failed across repeated access with no automatic retry, and an explicit reload starting another attempt. Only the first holds today: a Module body that raises during initialization aborts the whole load, so `load_package_tree` answers the error and nothing partial is exposed. The other two have no surface at all - the load returns Err instead of a runtime carrying failed Modules, so there is nothing to access twice, and no reload entry point exists. Supplying them means changing the shared load path to continue past a failure and record per-Module state, which the 54 vectors executing through that path all depend on, so it is a subsystem change rather than a missing surface.

expect.status: No partial Module is visible, both Modules remain failed without automatic retry, and only explicit reload starts another initialization attempt.
